title: Roster import artifact
description: Descriptor of an uploaded roster file. The roster pipeline is parse -> column mapping -> row validation -> preview -> human confirmation -> atomic write (RQ-B-1-10). Parsing never guesses: an unmappable column stops the import for a human decision, and no roster row is persisted before confirmation.

filename.description: Original client filename. Used for display only; the server never derives a storage path from it.

media_type.description: Only PDF and XLSX rosters are accepted. Anything else is rejected with 422.

content_sha256.description: Digest of the uploaded bytes; re-computed server-side and compared, so a tampered upload is rejected.

size_bytes.description: Upload size, bounded by the configured roster upload limit.

$comment: Target fields expected from the roster are 姓名 (display_name), 学号 (student_number), 课程编号 (course_code) and 课序号 (section_code); see MAIN/docs/requirements/rq-catalog.md RQ-B-1-10. Column headers are matched case- and whitespace-insensitively but never guessed when ambiguous.
